# pstack 0.9.35, reference copy

This folder is a read-only snapshot of [pstack-claude](https://github.com/michael-denyer/pstack-claude), the Claude Code port of Lauren Tan's pstack. It is MIT licensed. See `LICENSE` and `NOTICE.md`.

Claude Code does not load this folder. It loads the plugin enabled in `../../.claude/settings.json`. Keep this copy for reading. To update it, copy a newer version over it.

Start with these files:

- `skills/poteto-mode/SKILL.md` covers the working style and the playbooks.
- `skills/poteto-mode/playbooks/feature.md` is the playbook for each batch.
- `skills/unslop/SKILL.md` covers prose, including UI copy.
- `skills/deslop/SKILL.md` covers code cleanup before each commit.
- `skills/typescript-best-practices/SKILL.md` covers every `.ts` and `.tsx` file.
